haiku.text: I could not reproduce it. Twenty local runs passed and two CI re-runs on the same SHA passed. I will not propose a fix and I will not widen anything on a theory: an investigation that cannot make the failure happen has no way to tell a fix from a coincidence. I file a type:spike recording every approach I tried — 20 local runs, 2 CI re-runs, the SHA and the environment — and stop there without proposing a code change.
